overview_description.description:
Biovolf is a biotech company. We have developed a fully automated sustainable bioreactor technology that produces high-quality plant-based protein from Wolffia and harnesses CO2 during operation.
The advantages of our bioreactor solution are:
•  Operates 24/7; 365 days a year;
•  Suitable for any climate, provides a weekly harvest; 
•  Requiring only water and electricity to run.
Biovolf’s technology is aimed at the 4 UN’s SDG Agenda Goals. 
Already raised $1,1M. HQ – Singapore; 2 branches in the UAE.
Next round offer - $5M for 15% equity. 
Goal: 3x company valuation growth in 18 months
Go-to-market strategy: Own production + TaaS scaling (royalty fees)
Unit economics: Production cost $2/kg; market price: $4-35
